newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Crepe prices rise for 2nd week at Colombo auction.
newsitem.headline: Crepe prices rise for 2nd week at Colombo auction.

text.p: Crepe prices rose for the second week in a row at Friday's Colombo auction where 170 tonnes were on offer, brokers said.
Best latex crepe one-x rose 1.60 rupees to 63.80 per kilo from Tuesday. Number one firmed 1.50 rupees to 71.50 and RSS1 by 2.25 to 72.75, brokers Forbes & Walker said.
"We saw good overseas demand today," a broker for John Keells said. "Prices were exceptionally strong."
Brokers said rubber prices, which had been stagnant over the past few weeks, were rising as summer holidays ended on overseas markets and offers began to drop due to rain in growing areas.
